QUOTE: about 286 call occurrences across 29 library files
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the `mbedtls_ct_*` primitives are called in 29 library files, backed by a table of files across TLS, RSA, cipher, bignum, base64 and PSA. That is the same order of magnitude as twenty modules and clearly not confined to one or two.
